title: Account-transfer delays (fictional)
initial_observation: Some fictional transfer requests take longer than expected.
problem_statement: We suspect incomplete source information causes repeated handoffs, but the frequency and primary cause are unverified.

facts.claim: In the synthetic exercise dataset, cases A03 and A05 have recorded return-to-sender events.

assumptions: Incomplete initial data is the primary cause of delay.
unknowns: How much delay is queueing versus rework?
counterarguments: An approval queue, rather than missing information, may dominate elapsed time.

decisions.decision: Keep incomplete data as hypothesis, not established diagnosis
decisions.reason: Synthetic event records do not establish causality

options.description: Clarify required transfer documents up front
Test checklist assistance with existing approved tools
Explore event-driven exception routing if constraints permit

experiment.question: What proportion of delay comes from avoidable missing information?
experiment.method: Review a small approved representative sample and calculate time by state
experiment.success_signal: Attribution and repeatability of delay across sample
